about: One entry per music model the studio knows about. Facts come from each model's card or code, read on 2026-11-01. Proof comes from music_proof.json, written by scripts/build_music_page.py from real renders.

models.label: MiniMax Music 3
models.job: Full songs with vocals from a three-part caption and lyrics.
models.does: The strongest fit for the studio's style library: its caption format and its 1,056 style cards were written for it. It plans a song first, then renders it, so length is a ceiling and it may stop early. Runs in core ComfyUI.

licence.name: MiniMax-Music3 Community License
licence.use: Commercial use must show "MiniMax-Music3" prominently in the product. Above USD 20M a year you need written permission from MiniMax. ComfyUI's repackaged files are tagged Apache-2.0 on their page; the studio follows MiniMax's own licence, shipped as studio/LICENSE-MiniMax-Music3.txt.

can: 19 LoRAs on disk: turbo, genre and voice sliders

models.label: ACE-Step 1.5 XL Turbo
models.job: A 4B-parameter song model in eight steps.
models.does: Takes style tags, lyrics, BPM and key as separate fields. Eight steps with no guidance, so it is very quick for its size. The model card warns of rough vocals and dropped lyrics when the song is too short for its words.

licence.name: MIT (ACE-Step's own repository)
licence.use: MIT on ACE-Step's repository. ComfyUI's repackaged files are tagged Apache-2.0. Both allow commercial use; check the outputs' rights yourself.

can: Cover, extend, repaint, extract with RyanOnTheInside's pack

settings.Fields: tags, lyrics, BPM, key, time signature, language

models.label: ACE-Step 1.5 XL Base
models.job: The undistilled 4B model: 50 steps with guidance.
models.does: The same family as XL Turbo, without the shortcut. Much slower, with real guidance, and it is the one that can take the extract task, which separates one instrument out of a song.

licence.name: MIT (ACE-Step's own repository)
licence.use: MIT on ACE-Step's repository. ComfyUI's repackaged files are tagged Apache-2.0.

models.label: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo
models.job: The small 2B model. Songs on a modest card.
models.does: The lightest full-song model here, and the one to try first on a small GPU. Cover and extend work through RyanOnTheInside's guiders.

licence.name: MIT (ACE-Step's own repository)
licence.use: MIT on ACE-Step's repository. ComfyUI's repackaged files are tagged Apache-2.0.

can: Cover and extend with RyanOnTheInside's guiders

models.label: YuE2 3B (int8)
models.job: Writes a melody plan as sheet music, then sings it.
models.does: Two stages you can see: it writes ABC notation first, then renders audio from it. The int8 build needs the least memory of any song model here. Its card warns that instrumental-only requests can still gain vocals, and that some genres are weak.

licence.name: CC BY-NC 4.0
licence.use: Non-commercial only, on both M-A-P's and ComfyUI's pages.

can: Cover from reference audio, with SheetSage

models.label: YuE2 3B (bf16)
models.job: The same YuE2, at full precision.
models.does: The same model and graph as the int8 build, with the unquantized weights. Listed apart so the two can be compared on one brief.

models.label: Stable Audio Open 1.0
models.job: Short instrumental clips and sounds, no words.
models.does: Text to audio up to 47 seconds. It has no lyric input, so it renders the brief's instrumental version. It is here as the clip-and-texture tool, not a song model.

licence.name: Stability AI Community License
licence.use: Free under the licence's revenue limit; read the terms before commercial use.

models.label: Stable Audio 3
models.job: Newer Stable Audio: medium, small music, small sound effects.
models.does: ComfyUI ships graphs for it. The checkpoints are on this machine, but the text encoder they need, t5gemma_b_b_ul2, is not: only its card and a checksum marker are.

licence.name: Stability AI Community License
licence.use: Free under the licence's revenue limit; read the terms before commercial use.

models.label: DiffSynth-Music
models.job: ACE-Step 1.5 XL with extra control: beat, vocal, accompaniment, prosody.
models.does: Keeps a vocal and writes the band around it, or the reverse, or follows a click track. Runs from the DiffSynth-Studio Python package, not a ComfyUI graph. The weights are 33 GB and were not run for this page.

models.label: MuLaCover
models.job: Cover songs and remixes, from reference music or MIDI.
models.does: Transforms reference music using lyrics and a structured style line, or generates from melody and chord MIDI. It needs HeartCodec and a Qwen embedding beside it, and YourMT3 and ChordNet for reference audio.

models.label: Magenta RealTime 2
models.job: Live music you steer as it plays, on the device.
models.does: A streaming model: continuous audio, steered by text, audio examples and MIDI, with base (2.4B) and small (230M) sizes. It's a different kind of tool from a song model: no lyrics, and it never finishes a track.

licence.name: Apache-2.0 code, CC BY 4.0 weights
licence.use: Attribution required. Google claims no rights in outputs; you answer for what you make.

models.label: SongGeneration v2
models.job: Song generation, run through a community node pack.
models.does: Tencent AI Lab's song model. The community pack that runs it points at the v2 large checkpoint on a personal Hugging Face page, lglg666, which states no licence and has an empty card. Tencent's own Hugging Face page couldn't be read when this was written, so the licence stays unknown here.

licence.name: Unknown: the mirror states none
licence.use: Don't ship anything from this until the official licence is read.

models.label: TangoFlux
models.job: Fast text to sound. Sound effects more than songs.
models.does: Flow-matching text to audio. Its card describes audio generally rather than songs, so it's listed for textures and effects. No lyrics.

licence.name: Non-commercial research use
licence.use: Research and non-commercial use only: the card names Stable Audio Open's licence, among others.

models.label: MusicGen Small
models.does: Short instrumental clips from text, through Hugging Face transformers or a community pack. Meant as a baseline: much older than everything above it.

not_music.name: AuK
not_music.why: Sounds like it might be. Its card says speech generation, voice cloning and speech editing.

not_music.name: MOSS-SoundEffect
not_music.why: Sound effects, by its name and folder. Not a song model, and not read further.

not_music.name: Prism-Alpha audio_dit
not_music.why: The audio half of a video model.

not_music.name: MOVA audio diffusion
not_music.why: The audio half of a video model.

roti.author: RyanOnTheInside
roti.install:
cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
git clone https://github.com/ryanontheinside/ComfyUI_RyanOnTheInside.git
cd ComfyUI_RyanOnTheInside
pip install -r requirements.txt

packs.name: ComfyUI_RyanOnTheInside
packs.use: The one this page runs. Audio-reactive features, particles, flex image and mask nodes, and ACE-Step 1.5 guiders.

packs.name: ComfyUI_ControlFreak
packs.use: Maps MIDI controllers and gamepads to any node setting. A browser extension for ComfyUI, with no generation of its own.

packs.name: ComfyUI_ProfilerX
packs.use: Times nodes and tracks memory and cache hits. Version 2 says it no longer patches ComfyUI's core; our scan still flags a startup script.

packs.name: ComfyUI-CalculatorX
packs.use: A calculator node, for expressions and simple schedules.

packs.name: ComfyUI_RealtimeNodes
packs.use: Value animation, MediaPipe vision and motion nodes for real-time graphs. Its pyproject points at a LICENSE file that isn't there, so nothing here copies from it.

packs.name: ComfyUI_Doom
packs.use: Doom in ComfyUI, in its author's words, for posterity.

packs.name: ComfyUI-MineWorld
packs.use: Microsoft's MineWorld, marked work in progress.

packs.name: ComfyUI-DeepLiveCam
packs.use: Face swapping. Nothing to do with this page.

packs.name: ComfyUI-Livepeer
packs.use: Sends work to Livepeer's paid remote service, marked work in progress. Not local, so not for this studio.

packs.name: ComfyUI_SuperResolution
packs.use: Marked deprecated by its author, and moved elsewhere.

packs.name: ComfyUI_EfficientTAM
packs.use: A placeholder, marked work in progress, waiting on model weights.

packs.name: ComfyUI_YoloNasObjectDetection_Tensorrt
packs.use: Object detection, marked experimental. Nothing to do with this page.

risks: On load it deletes and rewrites its own folder inside ComfyUI's web/extensions, so it should not go straight into a shared install.
nodes/acestep/patches.py replaces one ComfyUI helper, reshape_mask, for everyone in that process.
Its Open-Unmix node runs torch.hub.load, which downloads and runs code and weights from GitHub the first time. That node wasn't run for this page.
The extend and repaint guiders download silence_latent.pt from ACE-Step's Hugging Face page the first time, loaded with weights_only=True.
